notes: Raw I/Q capture for dab-rs OFDM sync chain validation. Captured 2026-05-27 after switching to a 41 cm 1/4-λ monopole dipole (a previous rubber-duck WiFi antenna gave -45 dB worth of mismatch loss at VHF Band III; full diagnostic record at data/captures/diag/k8b_attempt_noise.json). All four quality gates pass: ADC fill -7.1 dBFS_12bit (clip 0%), PSD peak vs outer-5% noise floor +21.6 dB, 207 of 209 envelope dips spaced at exactly 96.00 ms (median), CP autocorrelation lock 98% over 50 consecutive symbol periods at Ts=3738 samples. Cross-check: eti-cmdline-airspy was run live on the same antenna/gain setup immediately before this capture and locked the YTN DMB ensemble (EId 0xE040) with all 5 services (mYTN / HD mYTN / 4DRIVE / LOTTE Homeshop / YTN EWS) at fibquality 6-18 and SNR ~7 dB. The SNR is below the k8b_100pct capture's ~13 dB (that capture used a Brisa flat-panel + USB-LNA setup), which manifests here as shallow envelope null dips (min/mean ratio ~0.72-0.78 instead of the textbook ~0.1-0.3) — characteristic of SFN multipath fill from the 5 metro-area K8B transmitters (Namsan / Gwanaksan / Yongmunsan / Gwanggyosan / Unjung). Despite the shallower dips, the 96 ms cadence is recovered cleanly. Intended use: cross-validation oracle for dab-rs OFDM stages 3a-3e (resample, null sync, CP autocorr, FFT framing, channel EQ, π/4-DQPSK demap) against eti-stuff.

environment.location: Sinnonhyeon (신논현), Seocho-gu, Seoul, Republic of Korea — indoor near window

g1_psd_contrast.note: Peak vs outer-5% noise floor +21.6 dB clears the 15 dB threshold; mean is dragged down by Airspy IF rolloff (~1 MHz), not by signal absence.

g2_null_period.note: 207 / 209 dips at exactly 96.00 ms (median) — DAB Mode I null cadence unambiguous. Dips are shallow (min/mu ~0.72) due to SFN multipath fill.

g3_cp_autocorr.note: 98% lock at +Ts intervals = OFDM symbol cadence stable across the capture.

g4_fic_live_decode.note: Live decode on the same RF setup (immediately before this I/Q capture) confirms an active YTN DMB ensemble with all 5 expected services.

intended_use: dab-rs OFDM Mode I sync chain validation (Week 3a-3e: resampler 3->2.048 MSPS, coarse null detect, CP autocorr fine sync, NCO correction, 2048-pt FFT framing, PRS channel EQ, pi/4-DQPSK demap).
